explanation: OEIS A179524 (a(n) = Σ_k (−4)^k C(n,k)² C(n−k,k)²), Z.-W. Sun: for primes p ≡ 1, 9 (mod 20) with p = x² + 5y², Σ_{k<p} a(k) ≡ 4x² − 2p (mod p²). The formal statement takes any integers x, y with p = x² + 5y² (x² is determined, so this is equivalent). Checked numerically for p < 300. Faithful.
